name: gen_batchlane
description: SoA 8-vol/zmm batch-lane (bl8 lineage): twiddle-free 2-stage PFA register-explicit pencils (10=2x5,12=3x4,15=3x5,20=4x5; stage1 mem->regs, stage2 regs->mem, 2L ld + 2L st per pencil), L1 zy-sweep + x-pass, fused chain in SoA with eager rsqrt14 map (rcp14 ladder at 10/12/15, vdivpd at 20), sched-pressure on 10/12 only (r4 same-core re-race), THP arena (gen_layout), plane stride 256 mod 4096
